Definition: from G1453; to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively):--be vigilant, wake, (be) watch(-ful).
BiblicalUsage: The word grēgoreúō carries the sense of to keep awake, to watch. In Matthew 24:42, the text says "Watch therefore." In Mark 13:35, the text says "Watch ye therefore."
TheologicalSignificance: I take grēgoreúō to mean that faithfulness is staying when staying is costly — the way God stays with us. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
